new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("somePath")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("requestHeaderNameTwo", "requestHeaderValueTwo"),
                        new Header("requestHeaderNameOne", "requestHeaderValueOneOne", "requestHeaderValueOneTwo")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameOne", "requestCookieValueOne"),
                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameTwo", "requestCookieValueTwo")
                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(
                        new Parameter("requestQueryStringParameterNameTwo", "requestQueryStringParameterValueTwo"),
                        new Parameter("requestQueryStringParameterNameOne", "requestQueryStringParameterValueOneOne", "requestQueryStringParameterValueOneTwo")
                )
                .withBody(new StringBody("somebody")),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(304)
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("responseHeaderNameTwo", "responseHeaderValueTwo"),
                        new Header("responseHeaderNameOne", "responseHeaderValueOneOne", "responseHeaderValueOneTwo")
                )
                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("responseCookieNameOne", "responseCookieValueOne"),
                        new Cookie("responseCookieNameTwo", "responseCookieValueTwo")
                )
                .withBody("responseBody")
                .withDelay(new Delay(TimeUnit.MINUTES, 1))
                .withConnectionOptions(
                        connectionOptions()
                                .withSuppressContentLengthHeader(true)
                                .withContentLengthHeaderOverride(10)
                                .withSuppressConnectionHeader(true)
                                .withKeepAliveOverride(true)
                                .withCloseSocket(true)
                )
);

                .withCookies(
                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameOne", "requestCookieValueOne"),

                )
                .withQueryStringParameters(

                )
                .withBody(new StringBody("somebody")),
        Times.once(),

)
.withId("<uuid>")
.forward(
        forwardOverriddenRequest()
                .withRequestOverride(
                        request()
                                .withMethod("GET")
                                .withPath("somePath")
                                .withHeaders(
                                        new Header("requestHeaderNameTwo", "requestHeaderValueTwo"),
                                        new Header("requestHeaderNameOne", "requestHeaderValueOneOne", "requestHeaderValueOneTwo")
                                )
                                .withCookies(
                                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameOne", "requestCookieValueOne"),
                                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameTwo", "requestCookieValueTwo")
                                )
                                .withQueryStringParameters(
                                        new Parameter("requestQueryStringParameterNameTwo", "requestQueryStringParameterValueTwo"),
                                        new Parameter("requestQueryStringParameterNameOne", "requestQueryStringParameterValueOneOne", "requestQueryStringParameterValueOneTwo")
                                )
                                .withBody(new StringBody("somebody"))
                )
                .withRequestModifier(
                        requestModifier()
                                .withPath("someRegex","someSubstitution")
                                .withQueryStringParameters(
                                        parameters(
                                                new Parameter("addNameTwo", "addValueTwo"),
                                                new Parameter("addNameOne", "addValueOne")
                                        ),
                                        parameters(
                                                new Parameter("replaceNameTwo", "replaceValueTwo"),
                                                new Parameter("replaceNameOne", "replaceValueOne")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("removeNameOne","removeNameTwo","removeNameThree")
                                )
                                .withHeaders(
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("addNameTwo", "addValueTwo"),
                                                new Header("addNameOne", "addValueOne")
                                        ),
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("replaceName", "replaceValue")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("removeNameOne","removeNameOne")
                                )
                                .withCookies(
                                        cookies(
                                                new Cookie("addName", "addValue")
                                        ),
                                        cookies(
                                                new Cookie("replaceNameOne", "replaceValueOne"),
                                                new Cookie("replaceNameTwo", "replaceValueTwo")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("removeName")
                                )
                )
                .withResponseOverride(
                        response()
                                .withHeaders(
                                        new Header("requestHeaderNameTwo", "requestHeaderValueTwo"),
                                        new Header("requestHeaderNameOne", "requestHeaderValueOneOne", "requestHeaderValueOneTwo")
                                )
                                .withCookies(
                                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameOne", "requestCookieValueOne"),
                                        new Cookie("requestCookieNameTwo", "requestCookieValueTwo")
                                )
                                .withBody("somebody")
                )
                .withResponseModifier(
                        responseModifier()
                                .withHeaders(
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("addName", "addValue")
                                        ),
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("replaceName", "replaceValue")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("removeName")
                                )
                                .withCookies(
                                        cookies(
                                                new Cookie("addName", "addValue")
                                        ),
                                        cookies(
                                                new Cookie("replaceName", "replaceValue")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("removeName")
                                )
                )
                .withDelay(new Delay(TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, 100))
);
